title: Experience
description: Assignments of Paratmos since 1998: logical data models, data architecture, analysis and coaching at VNG, the CAK, RVO, the KVK and Statistics Netherlands, among others.

config.markdown:
I have worked on software since 1998, with UML and use cases since 2001, and for the last fifteen years mainly on data architecture and the logical data model. Usually as a senior analyst, modeller or data architect, often with the task of raising the level of analysis of a team or a whole organisation.

The common thread: first the model, then what follows from it. Two assignments are worked out as cases, the rest is in the timeline. References are available on request.

items.title: VNG, Common Ground
items.markdown: Ongoing. From the bitemporal register as a principle to working components on Fundament.

items.title: KVK, the trade register
items.markdown: 2017–2020. The logical model of a base register, and a register that processes corrections without errors again.

items.title: VNG, Common Ground
items.markdown: The bitemporal register, the municipal data model (GGM), federated access control (FTV) and history in APIs. [Read more](/en/ervaring/common-ground)

items.title: The CAK, The Hague
items.markdown: Data architect: an organisation-wide logical data model, drawn up single-handedly and handed over to the architects (UML, Bizzdesign). Before that information analyst on the core application for the Social Support Act (Wmo).

items.title: RVO, Zwolle
items.markdown: Senior analyst, data architect and coach in the Common Agricultural Policy 2023–2027 programme. Responsible for the programme-wide logical model, in line with the conceptual model and the RVO terminology (MIM); the basis for the service interfaces of a central subsidy calculation.

items.title: CAI, Rijswijk
items.markdown: Trainer for IREB, UML, SysML, OCEB and BPM(N); co-developer of the trainings.

items.title: Dutch Tax Administration, Apeldoorn
items.markdown: Analysis of the message specifications and the model behind them for the European directive DAC6 (UML, XML, XSD).

items.title: KVK, Utrecht
items.markdown: Data modeller and information architect: the logical model of the entire trade register, the REST interfaces and the design for correction and repair. [Read the case](/en/ervaring/kvk)

items.title: SURFsara, Amsterdam
items.markdown: A data plan and a central domain model for planning the use of services, gathered in a short time through interviews and workshops.

items.title: Volkswagen Pon Financial Services, Amersfoort
items.markdown: Impact analyses and domain modelling for the online services: private lease, financial lease and insurance.

items.title: Statistics Netherlands (CBS), Heerlen
items.markdown: Led the drawing up of a new conceptual metamodel of the statistical concepts, as the basis for a data lake.

items.title: Justis (Ministry of Justice and Security), The Hague
items.markdown: Domain model and workflows (BPMN) around letters and certificates, the primary products of Justis.

items.title: Meyn, Oostzaan
items.markdown: A data plan and tightly worked-out domain models for an infrastructure renewal in an industrial environment.

items.title: Shell / Ortec, Zoetermeer
items.markdown: Specified a modelling and cost estimation tool with a team of seven analysts; jointly responsible for the shared data model.

items.title: Air France-KLM, Schiphol-Rijk
items.markdown: Coordinating information analyst for the ancillary products (extra baggage, seats, meals) sold through the website and kiosks.

items.title: Earlier
items.markdown: Among others ABN AMRO (mentor in the bank-wide introduction of RUP), the Dutch Tax Administration (Benefits), the Judiciary, the Probation Service, Essent Kabelkom and UWV. Started as a designer and programmer of web applications.
